title: Default room roles: member and an admin role for the creator; canChangeRoleDefinitions only for admin
description:
room-policy-04 §3, §8.1, §8.2, §8.6 and Appendix A.1 do not say what roles a room starts with; mimid-agent-core's default_roles is mimid's own choice (decision mimid-1wgh.52 item 4). Bead mimid-d4i0 (promised to Rohan Mahy and Konrad Kohbrok, Mark's mail of 2026-11-18) and bug mimid-y2hi ask for an admin role for the creator.

Chosen:

1. Roles: 1 "banned" (no capabilities, §8.1.3), 2 "member" (every user the agent adds), 3 "admin" (the room's creator, in the participant list the creator's first Commit sets).
2. member: canAddParticipant, canRemoveSelf, canRemoveOwnClient (decision mimid-1wgh.4.81.25), canSendMessage, canReceiveMessage, canReplyToMessage, canReactToMessage. Transitions (0,[2]), (2,[0]). canChangeRoleDefinitions moves to admin (mimid-y2hi): with it any member could give the member role canKick or anything else in one Commit.
3. admin: everything a member holds, plus canRemoveParticipant, canKick, canBan, canUnban, canChangeUserRole (§8.1.2, §8.1.3), canChangeRoomName/Description/Avatar/Subject/Mood (§8.2), canChangeRoomMembershipStyle, canChangeRoleDefinitions, canChangePreauthorizedUserList (§8.6). Transitions are A.1 group_admin's over roles 0-3: (0,[1,2,3]), (1,[0,2,3]), (2,[0,1,3]), (3,[0,1,2]). (3,[0]) is what lets the admin leave (§8.1.2 canRemoveSelf consults the holder's own role).
4. Not given: canDestroyRoom and canSendMLSReinitProposal (A.1 puts them in super_admin and policy_enforcer; mimid implements neither destroying a room nor ReInit), canAddOwnClient (members do not have it either), canOpenJoin (role 0 only).
5. Constraints: all minimums 0, no maximums. Readings: (a) admin minimum_participants_constraint = 1 as A.1 group_admin, so the room never loses its last admin; (b) 0. Chosen (b): with (a) the hub refuses any Commit that would leave no admin, so a sole admin's protocol-07 §3.5 leave, which another member commits by reference, would be refused, and the pending proposals would be in every later Commit of that epoch, blocking the room; mimid-agent has no role-change operation for handing admin over first. Members cannot demote, remove, kick or ban anyone, nor redefine roles, so the creator's admin role is lost only if the creator leaves or another admin changes it. Follow-up for (a): mimid-f3bk (label human).
6. Only rooms created from now on get these roles. A room keeps the roles_list it was created with; in older mimid-agent rooms every member keeps canChangeRoleDefinitions until someone changes the role list.
7. The hub does not yet check the §8.2 metadata capabilities (room_metadata updates need none); mimid-nfze.
